notes.title: Big v1.1 V-Hunter update!
notes.content:
Hey guys, I am coming here with a large V-Hunter update! Many of these were made for the port to the Nintendo Switch and I'm bringing them over to Steam. The updates are quality-of-life changes and a few cosmetic ones, including a new costume! I hope you all enjoy it!

- You can hold down movement controls now
- Enemies have a health counter now
- New Rawr Labs Dino costume
- Dynamite shows blast radius
- Enemies are blue when frozen by time skip
- Hard mode now allows 2 seconds per move and forces a wait in place instead of death
- Color highlighted text
- Option for green goop or red goop
- If monster goop spawns on a portal location, it will be removed when the portal appears
